items.text_th: ถ้าสัตว์ประหลาด ไม่ต้องใช้พาวเวอร์เพราะไม่จำกัดเวลาตกเหมือนปลามอนสเตอร์ ออพในรูปก็ช่วยได้เยอะคร้บ สำเร็จรวม 200% จากประสบการณ์ สำเร็จ 200% โอกาสตกแล้วไม่ขาดจะประมาณ 10 เงาตกได้ 6 ตัว แม้แต่ใส่สำเร็จ 5 ช่องก็ยังมีคนขาดมาแล้ว หรือแม้แต่ใช้เบ็ดไม้ที่ไม่มีอัตราสำเร็จเลยก็สามารถตกขึ้นได้
items.text_vn: Cá quái vật thì không cần chỉ số sức mạnh vì không giới hạn thời gian như cá monster, các dòng chỉ số trong ảnh giúp được nhiều rồi. Theo kinh nghiệm, tổng tỉ lệ thành công 200% thì khoảng 10 bóng cá câu được 6 con không đứt dây. Có người gắn đủ 5 dòng thành công vẫn đứt, còn dùng cần gỗ không có tỉ lệ thành công vẫn câu lên được.
items.text_en: For the monster creature you don't need power since there's no time limit like the monster fish; the stats in your picture help a lot. From experience, with 200% total success rate you land about 6 out of 10 shadows without the line breaking. Some people still snap with 5 success slots, and some land it with a plain wooden rod.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn chỉ số cần câu để câu cá quái vật, tỉ lệ đứt dây vẫn phụ thuộc may mắn.
items.summary_en: Explains rod stats for the monster creature; line breaks still depend on luck.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: กว่าจะตกได้ปลาตัวใหญ่(น่าจะเป็นจำพวกพวกปลายักษ์) พอได้แล้วกดมันบอกว่ากดช้าไป แก้ยังไงดีคะ ต้องอัพอะไรมั้ย

items.text_th: ตอนย้ายนี่ก็แอบงง อะแต่ดีที่ล็อกอินสตีมไว้มันเลยเข้าตัวเดิมได้ แต่ไปเล่นใน โกลบอลไม่ได้ละนะกลายเป็นตัวใหม่เลย
items.text_vn: Lúc chuyển mình cũng hơi rối, may mà có đăng nhập Steam nên vào lại được nhân vật cũ. Nhưng giờ vào bản Global thì không được nữa, thành nhân vật mới luôn.
items.text_en: The transfer confused me too; luckily I was logged in with Steam so I got my old character back. But on Global it's now a brand-new character.
items.summary_vn: Chuyển tài khoản hơi rối, nhờ đăng nhập Steam mới vào lại được nhân vật cũ.
items.summary_en: Transfer was confusing; got the old character back thanks to Steam login.
items.theme: Đăng nhập tài khoản
items.topic: Login / Account / Data

items.text_th: อาการนี้คือ เข้าผิดไอดีครับ ต้องจำให้ได้ว่าเราเชื่อมกับอะไีรไว้
items.text_vn: Trường hợp này là vào nhầm tài khoản rồi, phải nhớ mình đã liên kết bằng cái gì.
items.text_en: That means you logged into the wrong account; you need to remember what you linked it with.
items.summary_vn: Giải thích là đăng nhập nhầm tài khoản, cần nhớ phương thức liên kết.
items.summary_en: Explains it's the wrong account; remember which login method was linked.
items.theme: Đăng nhập tài khoản
items.topic: Login / Account / Data

items.text_th:
ขออวดหน่อยนะ 
— feeling loved.
items.text_vn: Cho mình khoe tí nha (đang thấy được yêu thương).
items.text_en: Let me show off a little (feeling loved).
items.summary_vn: Khoe thành quả (thú cưng/vật phẩm) vừa nhận được.
items.summary_en: Shows off something they just got.
items.theme: Trải nghiệm game tích cực
items.topic: Other

items.text_th: ปืนแรง ยิงได้ที่หนึ่งตัวนั้นไหมคะพอดีเห็นมีคนบอกต้องยิงให้ได้ที่หนึ่งถึงจะได้พอดีปืนเราไม่แรงไม่น่าจะสู้ใครได้
items.text_vn: Súng mạnh thì bắn được hạng nhất để lấy con đó không ạ? Thấy người ta nói phải bắn hạng nhất mới được, mà súng mình yếu chắc không đọ lại ai.
items.text_en: With a strong gun can you get first place for that one? People say you need first place to get it, but my gun is weak so I can't compete.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi có phải bắn hạng nhất mới nhận được thú cưng từ boss, súng yếu khó cạnh tranh.
items.summary_en: Asks if you must rank first to get the boss pet; their weak gun can't compete.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ได้แต่นั่งมองอีกแล้ว14ใบเลยนะ!!!ทำไงอ่ะถึงจะได้เบาบับมาปลูกเส้าา;-;
items.text_vn: Lại chỉ biết ngồi nhìn, 14 lá rồi đó!!! Làm sao mới có cây baobab để trồng đây huhu.
items.text_en: Again I can only sit and watch, 14 leaves already!!! How do I get a baobab to plant? ;-;
items.summary_vn: Than không kiếm được cây baobab để trồng, hỏi cách có.
items.summary_en: Complains they can't get a baobab to plant and asks how.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ทำไมผมไม่เจอบ้างมี6-7ต้น
items.text_vn: Sao mình chẳng gặp được (cây baobab), có 6–7 cây thôi.
items.text_en: Why don't I ever find any? I only have 6–7.
items.summary_vn: Than ít gặp cây baobab.
items.summary_en: Complains they rarely find baobabs.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ตัองเฝ้าสวน เมื่อวานช่วงกลางวันเราได้มา4ต้น ต้องเฝ้าสวยตลอดค่ะ
items.text_vn: Phải canh vườn, hôm qua buổi trưa mình được 4 cây, phải canh liên tục nhé.
items.text_en: You have to watch your garden; yesterday afternoon I got 4. Keep watching it.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên phải canh vườn liên tục mới có cây baobab.
items.summary_en: Advises watching the garden constantly to get baobabs.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: อยากทราบว่าสองอันนี้ดีไหมคะ พอดีเปิดกล่องได้ค่ะ ._.
items.text_vn: Cho hỏi hai món này có tốt không ạ? Mình mới mở hộp được.
items.text_en: Are these two any good? I just got them from a box.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi hai vật phẩm (cần câu) mở hộp được có tốt không.
items.summary_en: Asks if two items from a box are any good.
items.theme: Giá trị phần thưởng gacha
items.topic: Gacha / Shop / Pricing

items.text_th: คุ้มมั้ย ยิงบอสอยู่คนเดียว แต่ได้สัตว์เลี้ยงมาโดยไม่ต้องไปคราฟ
items.text_vn: Đáng không nè: bắn boss một mình mà rớt được thú cưng, khỏi cần chế tạo.
items.text_en: Worth it? I shot the boss solo and got the pet without crafting.
items.summary_vn: Khoe bắn boss một mình mà rớt thú cưng, không cần chế tạo.
items.summary_en: Shows off getting the pet from a solo boss fight without crafting.
items.theme: Trải nghiệm game tích cực
items.topic: Other

items.text_th: คุ้มค่ะ น้ำพักน้ำแรง 5555555 ตอนโทรลเรายิงคนเดียวยังไม่ออกเลย
items.text_vn: Đáng chứ, công sức bỏ ra mà haha. Hồi troll mình bắn một mình còn chẳng ra.
items.text_en: Totally worth it, hard work haha. When I solo-shot the troll I got nothing.
items.summary_vn: Khen đáng công, kể lúc bắn troll một mình không rớt gì.
items.summary_en: Says it was worth it; they got nothing soloing the troll.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ยิงคนเดียวท้อมาก ตัวเองยิงไปกี่นาทีคะ
items.text_vn: Bắn một mình nản lắm, bạn bắn mất bao nhiêu phút vậy?
items.text_en: Shooting solo is so discouraging. How many minutes did it take you?
items.summary_vn: Than bắn boss một mình rất nản, hỏi mất bao lâu.
items.summary_en: Says soloing the boss is discouraging and asks how long it took.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: อ่าวมันออกจากบอสได้ด้วยหรอครับนึกว่าต้องคราฟ
items.text_vn: Ủa boss cũng rớt được hả, tưởng phải chế tạo.
items.text_en: Oh, the boss can drop it too? I thought you had to craft it.
items.summary_vn: Ngạc nhiên vì thú cưng có thể rớt từ boss chứ không chỉ chế tạo.
items.summary_en: Surprised the pet can drop from the boss, not only crafting.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_vn: Người chơi miễn phí thì kiếm thẻ vàng nhiều ở đâu ạ?
items.text_en: For free-to-play players, where can I get lots of gold cards?

items.text_th: อย่าว่าแต่สายฟรีเลยครับสายเติมก็หนักกับคำว่าทองใบสุดท้าย
items.text_vn: Đừng nói người chơi miễn phí, người nạp tiền cũng khổ với tấm thẻ vàng cuối cùng.
items.text_en: Not just free players, even paying players struggle with that last gold card.
